text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente won the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
However, this isn't the end of their 
rivalry. She and Satono Crown vow to 
battle each other once more.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Duramente held a press 
conference and announced that her next 
race would be the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup brings together the nation's 
strongest Umamusume to decide who is the 
best in Japan. And Japan's strongest 
Umamusume will become the strongest in the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
That Umamusume was—Duramente herself. She 
had just issued a declaration of war to 
all of Japan. The title of Japan's best 
would be decided at the Japan Cup—
